name: refractjs-monorepo
description: Independent web-request engine under active development
author: RefractJS contributors

scripts.refract:build: pnpm exec tsc --project packages/refract-shared/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm exec tsc --project packages/refract-transports/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm exec tsc --project packages/refract-rewriter/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm exec tsc --project packages/refract-transport-fetch/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm exec tsc --project packages/refract-core/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.refract:check:run: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/refract-shared/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/refract-transports/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/refract-rewriter/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/refract-transport-fetch/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/refract-core/tsconfig.json
scripts.refract:test: pnpm run refract:build && pnpm run refract:test:run
scripts.refract:check: pnpm run refract:build && pnpm run refract:check:run
scripts.refract: pnpm run refract:build && pnpm run refract:test:run && pnpm run refract:check:run
scripts.legacy:build: pnpm --filter @mercuryworkshop/scramjet build && pnpm --filter create-proxy-app build && pnpm --filter @mercuryworkshop/scramjet-controller build && pnpm --filter @mercuryworkshop/proxy-bootstrap build && pnpm --filter @mercuryworkshop/scramjet-utils build && pnpm --filter @mercuryworkshop/scramjet-demo build
scripts.verify:workspace: pnpm refract && pnpm legacy:build && pnpm test:package && pnpm legacy:types
